ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.NAME, C.LOCATION, C.COUNTRY, C.ALT FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C WHERE (C.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R7.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R7 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C7 ON R7.CIRCUITID = C7.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S7 ON R7.YEAR = S7.YEAR WHERE (C7.COUNTRY) IN (SELECT C6.COUNTRY FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C6 WHERE C6.ALT IS NOT NULL AND (C6.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C5.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C5 WHERE (C5.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R4.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R4 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C4 ON R4.CIRCUITID = C4.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_CONSTRUCTORRESULTS CR4 ON CR4.RACEID = R4.RACEID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S4 ON R4.YEAR = S4.YEAR WHERE (R4.RACEID) IN (SELECT R3.RACEID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R3 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C3 ON R3.CIRCUITID = C3.CIRCUITID WHERE (R3.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C2.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C2 WHERE (C2.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C1.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C1 WHERE C1.COUNTRY IN ('Malaysia', 'Bahrain', 'Spain')) AND C2.ALT >= 100))) AND C5.NAME LIKE '%Circuit%') GROUP BY C6.COUNTRY)) AND C.ALT >= 200 ORDER BY C.ALT DESC

interactions.utterance: For races at those 200-meter-plus circuits, summarize the pit stops by circuit with the number of stops and average stop time in milliseconds.
interactions.intention: For races held at the previously selected circuits at least 200 meters high, report each circuit's pit-stop count and average pit-stop duration in milliseconds.

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.CIRCUITID, C.NAME AS CIRCUIT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS PIT_STOP_COUNT, AVG(P.MILLISECONDS) AS AVG_PIT_STOP_MILLISECONDS FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C JOIN FORMULA_1_RACES R ON R.CIRCUITID = C.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_PITSTOPS P ON P.RACEID = R.RACEID WHERE (C.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C8.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C8 WHERE (C8.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R7.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R7 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C7 ON R7.CIRCUITID = C7.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S7 ON R7.YEAR = S7.YEAR WHERE (C7.COUNTRY) IN (SELECT C6.COUNTRY FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C6 WHERE C6.ALT IS NOT NULL AND (C6.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C5.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C5 WHERE (C5.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R4.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R4 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C4 ON R4.CIRCUITID = C4.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_CONSTRUCTORRESULTS CR4 ON CR4.RACEID = R4.RACEID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S4 ON R4.YEAR = S4.YEAR WHERE (R4.RACEID) IN (SELECT R3.RACEID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R3 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C3 ON R3.CIRCUITID = C3.CIRCUITID WHERE (R3.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C2.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C2 WHERE (C2.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C1.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C1 WHERE C1.COUNTRY IN ('Malaysia', 'Bahrain', 'Spain')) AND C2.ALT >= 100))) AND C5.NAME LIKE '%Circuit%') GROUP BY C6.COUNTRY)) AND C8.ALT >= 200) GROUP BY C.CIRCUITID, C.NAME ORDER BY PIT_STOP_COUNT DESC, C.NAME ASC

ground_truths.golden_sql: SELECT C.COUNTRY, COUNT(C.CIRCUITID) AS CIRCUIT_COUNT, AVG(C.ALT) AS AVG_ALTITUDE FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C WHERE (C.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C9.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C9 JOIN FORMULA_1_RACES R9 ON R9.CIRCUITID = C9.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_PITSTOPS P9 ON P9.RACEID = R9.RACEID WHERE (C9.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C8.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C8 WHERE (C8.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R7.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R7 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C7 ON R7.CIRCUITID = C7.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S7 ON R7.YEAR = S7.YEAR WHERE (C7.COUNTRY) IN (SELECT C6.COUNTRY FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C6 WHERE C6.ALT IS NOT NULL AND (C6.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C5.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C5 WHERE (C5.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT R4.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R4 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C4 ON R4.CIRCUITID = C4.CIRCUITID JOIN FORMULA_1_CONSTRUCTORRESULTS CR4 ON CR4.RACEID = R4.RACEID JOIN FORMULA_1_SEASONS S4 ON R4.YEAR = S4.YEAR WHERE (R4.RACEID) IN (SELECT R3.RACEID FROM FORMULA_1_RACES R3 JOIN FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C3 ON R3.CIRCUITID = C3.CIRCUITID WHERE (R3.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C2.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C2 WHERE (C2.CIRCUITID) IN (SELECT C1.CIRCUITID FROM FORMULA_1_CIRCUITS C1 WHERE C1.COUNTRY IN ('Malaysia', 'Bahrain', 'Spain')) AND C2.ALT >= 100))) AND C5.NAME LIKE '%Circuit%') GROUP BY C6.COUNTRY)) AND C8.ALT >= 200)) GROUP BY C.COUNTRY ORDER BY AVG(C.ALT) DESC
